title: Launched the Steam Wishlist for my massive game project
author: pianokayak
selftext:
I’ve been working on this for about 5 months. About 400 hours in so far. Maybe a little more. My kids and I have been building it together.

But it’s turned into something much bigger than I ever expected. 

Think Satisfactory meets Jurassic Park, with a bit of Back to the Future involved.

Essentially, you and your team built a time machine in the year 2100 and set up an expedition to go back in time and see the dinosaurs.

But as you land, there was some interference and your team is separated and your gear was thrown all over a land about 3x the size of Satisfactory.

And then, a t-rex destroys the return capsule as you emerge from the wreckage. 

Now, you have to rebuild a time machine while dinosaurs hunt you and without most of your gear! 

But your handy, personal AI and just enough of your tech survived so that you can recover it all, build a crazy complex factory that enables you to rebuild the time machine, and find your way home.

If you’re interested, you can wishlist it on Steam and follow along. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/5523150/Back\_in\_Time\_Operation\_Amber/
